title: Foothill Studio Near Campus
address: 1185 Foothill Blvd, Unit 8, San Luis Obispo, CA 93405
description_and_lease_text: Cozy studio 0.9 miles from Cal Poly. All utilities (water, sewer, trash, electricity, gas, and WiFi) included in base rent. Street parking only (City of SLO residential permit required). Shared laundry on-site, no dishwasher, wall A/C unit. Subletting permitted during summer with standard application. No pets allowed.
